name: dsh-mobile-sync
description: Sync DSH conversations, plugins, skills and model groups (one provider at a time) between a desktop DeepSeek Harness and the kelai141/dsh-mobile-apk Android app over the LAN, paired by a QR code. Workspaces are ticked one by one, nothing is ticked by default, and a sync starts only when the panel's button is pressed.
